description: Makes an exploded view of an assembly in one call (SOLIDWORKS' Explode): a new view in the active configuration holding every step given, in order. Lengths in mm, angles in degrees. A step's direction is x, y or z (the assembly's axes), a straight edge, an axis, or a plane or planar face's normal: a reference issued in the assembly, name@component (Axis1@plate-1), or with direction_component a reference issued in that component's own part. Checked step by step: after each step the view is shown exploded and every component read; the step's components must have moved distance_mm along the direction from where the previous steps left them, then turned angle_deg about rotate_about, within 0.001 mm and 0.01 degrees, and no other component may have moved. SOLIDWORKS chooses which way along a direction and about an axis it goes; each step's sense says which, and reverse flips it. Then the assembly is collapsed again (or shows what it showed before) and every component must be back where it was. Otherwise the view is deleted (rolled back). Show it with explode.show, list it with explode.list, delete it with explode.delete. References are opaque: pass one back exactly as it was given, and never build or change one.

document.description: The assembly: its title or full path. The active document when absent.

configuration.description: The configuration to make the view in; it must be the active one (configuration.activate changes that). The active configuration when absent.

name.description: The view's name; SOLIDWORKS' own (ExplView1) when absent.

items.description: One step of an exploded view: components moved along a direction, and optionally turned about an axis afterwards.

components.description: The components to move: each a reference (r1.component.…) or a name (pin-1). Top-level, resolved components.

direction.description: Which way to move them: x, y or z (the assembly's own axes, the normals of its right, top and front planes), or a straight edge, an axis, or a plane or planar face (along its normal), in the assembly: a reference issued in the assembly (model.find), name@component (Axis1@plate-1), or with direction_component a reference issued in that component's own part.

direction_component.description: Only when direction is a reference issued in a component's own part (or a name there): that component, by reference or name.

distance_mm.description: How far to move them, mm, more than 0 and at most 10000.

reverse.description: Go the other way along the direction. Default false.

rotate_about.description: An axis to turn them about once moved: an axis, a straight or circular edge, or a cylindrical or conical face, in the forms direction takes. With angle_deg.

rotate_about_component.description: Only when rotate_about is a reference issued in a component's own part (or a name there): that component, by reference or name.

angle_deg.description: How far to turn them about rotate_about, degrees, more than 0 and at most 360. With rotate_about.
